counterfactual_text: A continuous water stream enters the glass and raises its level while the pitcher water level remains unchanged.
positive_text: A continuous water stream connects the pitcher and glass while the pitcher level falls and the glass level rises together.
semantic_text: A transparent pitcher pours water into an empty clear glass; the pitcher level falls while the glass level rises. Required visible entities: one transparent pitcher containing water; one empty clear glass; level support surface. At the beginning: pitcher: intact and visibly filled with water; glass: intact, clear, empty, and spatially separated from the pitcher spout. Required state changes: pitcher water level: high to lower; glass water level: empty to higher; water configuration: source volume to stream and target volume. These event variables are allowed to change: pitcher orientation; pitcher water level; glass water level; water-stream shape. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; container identities and transparency; level surface and background; one transparent pitcher; one empty clear glass at the start; the same water and level surface.
